Maya (CS): Heads-up 111111111111 Vevra returned our vendor questionnaire and wants super-clear language around embeddings retention, deletion SLA, and where inference data actually lives for their Dedicated cluster. Renewal ~45 days, this could affect renewal.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Can we give them a 2-3 line plain-English blurb plus a pointer to evidence? they need something to paste into their form.
Sophia (Security): Short answer: Dedicated keeps inference traffic and KV cache within the customer's dedicated compute in the selected region. Embeddings are stored in the customer's workspace storage (encrypted at rest). We should include exact retention options and KMS ownership.
Ken (Acct Exec): Their security lead wants explicit retention numbers for all artefacts: prompts, responses, embeddings, and control plane logs. Also wants to know if we support BYOK and proof of deletion.
Maya (CS): Let's produce one paragraph + an evidence zip with (a) SOC2 excerpt, (b) KMS integration notes, (c) sample deletion confirmation. I can offer a 30-min call with their security lead.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Draft paragraph (drop-in): `Data residency: Dedicated deployments run in tenant-isolated compute in the selected cloud region; inference requests and KV cache remain on tenant resources. Embeddings: default retention 90 days, configurable to 0/30/90/365 days for enterprise tenants. Deletion/export: submit via support portal; Dedicated deletion SLA 7 days, Hosted deletion SLA 14 days. Encryption: workspace storage encrypted with AES-256; envelope encryption via KMS. KMS: BYOK supported for Private deployments; Dedicated uses tenant-scoped managed keys unless BYOK enterprise integration is requested.`
Sophia (Security): Slight edits: replace "tenant-scoped managed keys" with "tenant-scoped Redwood-managed keys" and add a sentence: `We can provide proof-of-deletion samples and audit log excerpts for SOC2 reviewers upon request.` Also reference control IDs: CC3.4 (logging) and CC5.1 (encryption) in evidence pack.
Maya (CS): Good. Ken, can you propose Wed 10am PT for the call and loop Legal if they want contract language adjusted?
Ken (Acct Exec): Yep, sending calendar invite to Vevra security (cc:legal).
evidence-bot: Evidence package generated: `vevra-1770004321-evidence.zip` (includes SOC2 control excerpts, KMS integration doc, sample deletion log). URL: https://files.redwood.example/vevra-1770004321-evidence.zip
Maya (CS): Sent paragraph + evidence link to Vevra, scheduled Wed 10am PT. I'll update after call. :thumbsup: :calendar: 
Liam (Solutions Eng): If they ask about caching: note KV cache is ephemeral and evicted based on LRU; we do not persist KV cache beyond the inference lifecycle unless explicitly configured to store embeddings.
Sophia (Security): Also add: control plane telemetry (errors/metrics) may be visible to Redwood control plane for Hosted; for Dedicated we minimize control plane data and retain control plane logs 30 days by default. Add that to evidence.
Maya (CS): Action list: (1) Liam finalize paragraph and short FAQ bullets, (2) Sophia append SOC2 refs + deletion sample, (3) Ken run scheduling/legal, (4) Maya follow up with Vevra post-call and update renewal risk. Will close thread after post-call notes.
